headline: Cencora’s (NYSE:COR) Q2 CY2026 Earnings Results: Revenue In Line With Expectations
summary: Healthcare distributor Cencora (NYSE:COR) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.1% year on year to $84.75 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.48 per share was 3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

summary: CONSHOHOCKEN, Pa., August 05, 2026--Cencora, Inc.
